recognize_zh: 周邊血中多顆中小型淋巴球，細胞質深藍、核形不規則；箭頭所指細胞核有明顯凹陷／皺褶，右上細胞可見單一核仁，符合 T 細胞前淋巴球白血病（T-PLL）的核不規則型態。
features: Small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with moderate amount of deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm
Irregular nuclear contours with notches and indentations (arrow)
Moderately condensed chromatin; a single visible nucleolus in some cells (upper right)
Moderate N:C ratio, higher than in typical small mature lymphocytes
A larger cell with pale gray cytoplasm and folded nucleus at lower right, likely a monocyte
Background red cells with rouleaux-like stacking; rare platelet
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with moderately abundant, deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm. Nuclei are irregular with notches and indentations (arrow), chromatin is moderately condensed, and a single nucleolus is visible in some cells. A cell with pale gray cytoplasm and a folded nucleus, likely a monocyte, is also present. Findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia (irregular-nucleus variant), to be confirmed by flow cytometry and TCL1A/inv(14) studies.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells have cerebriform, grooved nuclei with scant pale cytoplasm and lack prominent nucleoli; clinical erythroderma and CD26 loss support Sezary.

ddx.dx: B-cell prolymphocytic leukemia / CLL with increased prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: B-prolymphocytes are typically round-nucleated with a prominent central nucleolus and express B-cell markers rather than CD3/CD7 with TCL1 overexpression.
ATLL shows polylobated 'flower cells' with more condensed chromatin and is HTLV-1 positive and usually CD7 negative, CD25 positive.
Hairy cells have pale gray-blue cytoplasm with circumferential hairy projections and oval/bean-shaped nuclei rather than deeply basophilic cytoplasm.
